build_PinocchioIKSolver: build a PinocchioIKSolver from a URDF file with an end-effector link and controlled joints list
compute_ik_PinocchioIKSolver: compute inverse kinematics for a desired end-effector position and quaternion using the PinocchioIKSolver
compute_fk_PinocchioIKSolver: compute forward kinematics to get end-effector position and quaternion from joint values using PinocchioIKSolver
build_PositionIKOptimizer: build a PositionIKOptimizer wrapping a PinocchioIKSolver to jointly optimize IK and orientation using CEM
optimize_CEM: optimize a cost function using the CEM solver with configurable iterations, samples, and tolerance
